entities.summary: Gwilym Peter Lewis is a British botanist, a curator at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and a leading expert on neotropical Leguminosae. The standard author abbreviation G.P.Lewis is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
